hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the template K(n)*u(n) by fixing u(n)=a(n) for the first term and u(n)=b(n) for the second term.
required_assumptions: K(n), a(n), and b(n) are well-defined at the same index n
Multiplication is the usual pointwise multiplication
hypotheses.rationale: Both non-identical terms share the same outer multiplicative factor K(n), so they are two specializations of a common repeated kernel template acting on different coefficient functions a(n) and b(n).
